access_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been accessed
access_count.title: 访问次数

created_at.description_en: The time when the share was created
created_at.title: 创建时间

disable_download.description_en: Specifies whether to disable downloading of files in the share
disable_download.description_zh: 禁止下载分享中的文件
disable_download.title: 禁止下载分享中的文件

disable_preview.description_en: Specifies whether to disable previewing of files in the share
disable_preview.description_zh: 禁止预览分享中的文件
disable_preview.title: 禁止预览分享中的文件

disable_save.description_en: Specifies whether to disable saving of files in the share
disable_save.description_zh: 禁止转存分享中的文件
disable_save.title: 禁止转存分享中的文件

download_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been downloaded
download_count.title: 下载次数

download_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be downloaded
download_limit.title: 分享下载次数限制

expiration.description_en: The expiration time. The value is in RFC 3339 format, for example, "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00". An empty string ("") indicates that the share never expires
expiration.title: 到期时间

expired.description_en: Indicates whether the share has expired
expired.title: 是否过期

file_id_list.description_en: The list of file IDs in the shared parent path
file_id_list.title: 分享父路径文件id列表

office_editable.description_en: Specifies whether online editing of shared documents is allowed
office_editable.description_zh: 是否允许在线编辑分享的文档
office_editable.title: 是否允许在线编辑分享的文档

preview_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been previewed
preview_count.title: 预览次数

preview_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be previewed
preview_limit.title: 分享预览次数限制

report_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been reported
report_count.title: 被举报次数

save_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been saved
save_count.title: 转存次数

save_download_limit.description_en: The maximum total number of times the share can be saved and downloaded
save_download_limit.description_zh: 分享转存和下载次数总和限制
save_download_limit.title: 分享转存和下载次数总和限制

save_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be saved
save_limit.title: 分享转存次数限制

share_all_files.description_en: Indicates whether all files in the drive are shared
share_all_files.description_zh: 是否分享整个drive中的文件
share_all_files.title: 是否分享整个drive中的文件

share_name.description_en: The share name. By default, the name of the first file is used
share_name.description_zh: 分享名，默认使用第一个文件名
share_name.title: 分享名称

share_pwd.description_en: The extraction code, which is 0 to 64 characters in length. A length of 0 indicates that no extraction code is set
share_pwd.description_zh: 提取码，0-64个字符。长度0表示没有提取码
share_pwd.title: 分享密码

status.description_en:
The status of the share. Valid values:
disabled: Canceled.
enabled: Active
status.description_zh:
状态。
枚举值如下：
disabled（已取消）
enabled（有效）
status.title: 状态

updated_at.description_en: The time when the share was last modified
updated_at.title: 修改时间

video_preview_count.description_en: The number of times audio and video files in the share have been played
video_preview_count.title: 音视频播放次数

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the creators.
1) If this parameter is not specified, the search scope depends on the user's role:
    - A drive administrator or super administrator can search for shares from all members.
    - A team administrator can search for shares from team members.
    - A regular user can only search for their own shares.



2) You can only specify user IDs that are within your role's search scope, as described in point 1)
parameters.help_zh:
分享创建者（user_id）
1）如果不指定, 那么会根据用户本身的权限进行查询
1.1 网盘管理员/超管：所有成员
1.2 团队管理员：团队成员
1.3 普通用户：自身

2）如果指定, 那么只能指定那些有权限的成员, 参考1）
parameters.name: creators

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of shares to return. Valid values: 1-100. Default: 100.

The number of shares returned may be less than the specified limit
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回资源的数量，取值范围[1,100]。如果没有填写，默认取值100。

返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不能多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
Use the `next_marker` value from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results.
If this parameter is not specified, the first page of results is returned.
parameters.help_zh:
设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回。如果不设定，则从头开始返回数据。
默认值：无
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The sort field.
By default, results are sorted by creation time in descending order.
Valid values:

`share_name`: The share name.

`updated_at`: The update time.

`description`: The description.

`created_at`: The creation time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。
默认按照创建时间倒序排列。
枚举值如下：
share_name（分享名称）
updated_at（修改时间）
description（描述）
created_at（创建时间）
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order.
If the sort field is `created_at` or `updated_at`, the default order is descending. For other sort fields, the default order is ascending.
Valid values:

`ASC`: ascending

`DESC`: descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。
如果是排序字段是created_at或者updated_at，则默认是倒序，其他排序字段默认是升序。
枚举值如下：
ASC（升序）
DESC（降序）
parameters.name: order_direction

parameters.example: created_at>='2022-01-18T02:50:00' and created_at<'2022-01-19T09:45:28' and share_name_for_fuzzy match 'HD.mp4' and status in ['enabled', 'disabled'] and expired_time='1970-01-01T00:00:00'
parameters.help_en:
The query conditions.
1) Supported fields:
    1.1 `created_at`: The creation time.
    1.2 `updated_at`: The update time.
    1.3 `share_name_for_fuzzy`: The share name. Fuzzy search (`match`) is supported.
    1.4 `status`: The share status. Valid values: `enabled` (active) or `disabled` (canceled).
    1.5 `expired_time`: The expiration time.
    To search for shares that never expire, set `expired_time='1970-01-01T00:00:00'`. For these shares, the `expiration` field in the response is an empty string.
    The time range `expired_time<'1970-01-02T00:00:00'` is reserved for system use and does not represent a valid expiration time.
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件
1）支持字段：
1.1 created_at 创建时间
1.2 updated_at 更新时间
1.3 share_name_for_fuzzy 分享名, 支持模糊匹配（match）
1.4 status 分享状态, 
枚举值 enabled（分享中）/disabled（已取消）
1.5 expired_time 超时时间
永不过期：expired_time='1970-01-01T00:00:00', 返回的expiration=""
expired_time<'1970-01-02T00:00:00'系统保留使用,不表示具体时间
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the total count of matched shares
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回搜到到的总记录数
parameters.name: return_total_count
